verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an llms.txt file or agent-oriented documentation describing the product for agents to consume, and the probe for a markdown docs endpoint returned HTTP 404. The SKILL.md files are the product's payload of agent instructions, not docs about the product, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
